project_type: Next.js 16.3.6 App Router marketing site (React 19.2.8, Tailwind 4, CSS modules), content in TypeScript/TSX files, no CMS, no database
build_system: npm + next build (Turbopack default in Next 16). No cacheComponents in next.config.ts, so route segment `revalidate` (literal number) and `dynamicParams` are valid. Windows + PowerShell: set env for one build with `$env:CONTENT_NOW="2026-12-31"; npm run build; Remove-Item Env:CONTENT_NOW`.
test_framework: No unit test framework. Verification = `npm run lint` + `npm run build` + production serve + zero-dependency SEO crawler (.kiro/skills/seo-audit/scripts/audit.mjs) + reading rendered HTML with curl/Invoke-WebRequest + optional `npx --yes lighthouse`.
test_command: npm run lint; npm run build; start `npx next start -p 3100` as a BACKGROUND process; node .kiro/skills/seo-audit/scripts/audit.mjs http://localhost:3100 --out .agents/seo-audit-2026-10-04.md (exit 1 = errors); stop the server afterwards
verification_instructions: 1) npm run lint (clean). 2) npm run build (passes; check route table shows ISR revalidate 1h on insights/home/sitemap/llms/landing routes after FEAT-001). 3) npx next start -p 3100 in background (port 3000 often busy). 4) Run the crawler against http://localhost:3100; 0 errors required; compare warnings with the baseline (56 pages, 25 warnings: 22 long titles, long descriptions on / and /insights; info: /academy h1->h3, /insights no BreadcrumbList). 5) Inspect rendered HTML for the specific feature (curl.exe -s http://localhost:3100/<path>). 6) For scheduled posts: one normal build (future posts must 404 and be absent from /insights, /sitemap.xml, /llms.txt, related links, home teaser) and one build with CONTENT_NOW=2026-12-31 (all posts render; crawler clean). 7) Stop the server. Never tick a checklist item from code reading alone.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. .next/ is build output (gitignored). Crawler report goes to .agents/seo-audit-2026-10-04.md; Lighthouse JSON to .agents/lh-*.json.
environment_constraints: Work in place in d:\Bright infonet web\brightinfonet-web (no worktree). NEVER git commit or push. Port 3000 is often busy: use 3100. Do not install anything globally; no new npm dependencies (GA4 via next/script). Do not run scripts/indexnow-submit.mjs (outbound submission is the owner's job). System date is 2026-10-04 IST. Read node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/... guides before touching metadata, sitemap, robots, OG images, routing, ISR or scripts (AGENTS.md: 'This is NOT the Next.js you know'). Remove any temporary dummy data/test posts before finishing a FEAT.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: read the relevant Next 16 doc before writing code. Skill .kiro/skills/seo-audit/SKILL.md: fix rules (URL changes need 301 in next.config.ts), new-page checklist (unique title+description, canonical, one h1, direct answer at top, 3+ internal links in and out, visible FAQ + FAQPage schema, BreadcrumbList, page-type schema, OG image, sitemap + llms.txt, linked from a hub/footer, SEO-PLAN.md table), report format. HARD RULES: never invent reviews, ratings, testimonials, client names/logos, case-study numbers, prices/fees, addresses, timings, author names, placement stats, survey data; costs/salaries labelled 'indicative' with ranges + 'get a written quote'; no competitor claims / Top-10 lists / superlatives; no backdating; keep existing post dates; `updated` only on real edits; owner-data features render nothing when unset.
key_patterns: Landing pages are data objects of type `Landing` (src/content/landing/types.ts) rendered by src/components/pages/LandingView.tsx; schema via landingJsonLd/landingMetadata in src/components/pages/landing-seo.ts; generic helpers (pageMetadata, breadcrumbJsonLd, breadcrumbTrailJsonLd, faqJsonLd, postalAddressJsonLd, areaServedJsonLd) in src/components/pages/seo.ts. Routes src/app/services/[slug], src/app/[slug] (local), src/app/academy/[slug] use generateStaticParams + dynamicParams=false + landingBySlug/slugOf. Blog posts are `Post` objects (src/content/insights/types.ts) in src/content/insights/<file>.tsx using Prose components (DataTable, Checklist, Callout from src/components/insights/Prose.tsx) and next/link; registered in src/content/insights/index.ts (POSTS sorted by published desc). Post page src/app/insights/[slug]/page.tsx renders JSON-LD (BlogPosting, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList) with JsonLd from src/lib/json-ld.tsx. Business facts in src/lib/site-config.ts (empty fields hidden). Home SERVICES (src/components/home/data.ts) and SERVICE_DETAILS (src/components/pages/content.ts) are PARALLEL arrays indexed together (Footer, /services page), and ServiceVisuals.tsx renders visuals by index. Inner pages use PageLayout (skip link, Header, main, Footer) + PageHero. Reveal/SplitText animations in src/components/home/motion; Motion.module.css already has prefers-reduced-motion rules. Contact form (src/components/home/Contact.tsx, client) builds a mailto: link. FloatingContact shows tel/WhatsApp. Layout title template '%s | Bright Infonet'.
relevant_files: .agents/tasks/seo-plan-impl.md (THE PLAN: design decisions D1-D6, items 1-14, schedule table)
directory_structure: src/app = routes (App Router) incl. metadata routes robots.ts, sitemap.ts, llms.txt/route.ts, opengraph-image.tsx; src/components/home = home sections + shared Header/Footer/motion; src/components/pages = inner-page template, LandingView, seo helpers, static page content; src/components/insights = blog UI; src/content/landing = landing page data (services, local, academy); src/content/insights = blog posts; src/lib = site-config, json-ld, brand-image; public/brand = logos; .kiro/skills/seo-audit = SEO skill + crawler; .agents = workflow artifacts and reports (not site code).
